title: Cambridge IELTS 14 Academic Speaking Test 1
description: Haqiqiy IELTS/CEFR Speaking formati: Rasmiy Cambridge IELTS 14 Test 1 bo‘yicha Part 1 (Kirish va kundalik mavzular), Part 2 (Cue Card taqdimot) va Part 3 (Tahliliy munozara).

sections.title: Speaking Assessment (Parts 1-3)
sections.instructions: Ushbu bo‘lim 3 ta qismdan iborat. Har bir qism topshirig‘i bilan tanishib chiqing, tayyor bo‘lgach mikrofon tugmasini bosib ovozingizni yozing va saqlang.

questions.question_text:
Part 1: Introduction & Everyday Topics (Speak for 1-2 minutes)

1. What job would you like to have ten years from now? [Why?]
2. How useful will English be for your future? [Why/why not?]
3. How much travelling do you hope to do in the future? [Why/why not?]
4. How do you think your life will change in the future? [Why/why not?]

Part 2: Individual Long Turn / Cue Card (1 minute preparation, 2 minutes speaking)

Describe a book that you enjoyed reading because you had to think a lot.
You should say:
• What this book was
• Why you decided to read it
• What reading this book made you think about
And explain why you enjoyed reading this book.

Part 3: Two-way Discussion (Speak for 2-3 minutes)

1. What are the most popular types of children's books in your country?
2. What are the benefits of parents reading books to their children?
3. Should parents always let children choose the books they read?
4. How popular are electronic books are in your country?
5. What are the advantages of parents reading electronic books (compared to printed books)?
6. Will electronic books ever completely replace printed books in the future?
